posts.en:
dsh-homepage-skin is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Adds the DeepSeek Harness homepage background to dsh web: WebGL fluid light, dot-line grid and a digital point-cloud whale, with dark and light palettes.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-ec860023331cc7f8422f.html
